description: This file defines API endpoints for authentication operations such as registration, login, logout, and retrieving current user information, using FastAPI and SQLAlchemy.

classes.name: User
classes.description: Represents a user entity in the database.

classes.name: Message
classes.description: Schema for simple messages returned by the API.

classes.name: UserCreate
classes.description: Schema for user registration input data.

classes.name: UserOut
classes.description: Schema for user data returned in responses.

methods.name: register(data: UserCreate, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Handles user registration, creates a new user if email is not registered.

methods.name: login(data: UserCreate, response: Response, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Authenticates user and sets JWT token in cookie.

methods.name: None set_cookie_response(response: Response, token: str)
methods.description: Sets authentication cookie in the response.

methods.name: logout(response: Response)
methods.description: Clears authentication cookie to log out the user.

methods.name: me(current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Returns the current authenticated user's information.

ctags.name: login
ctags.pattern: /^def login(data: UserCreate, response: Response, db: Session = Depends(get_db)):$/
ctags.signature: (data: UserCreate, response: Response, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
